bullets.text: Perplexity Shines on Galaxy S26 - **Samsung** integrates **Perplexity's** AI, enhancing user experience with new features.
Privacy Display Innovation - **Samsung's** Galaxy S26 Ultra introduces a groundbreaking Privacy Display feature for enhanced security.
Galaxy S26 Series Unveiled - **Samsung** launches its Galaxy S26 lineup with notable upgrades and AI enhancements.
Gemini Automates Tasks - **Google's** Gemini can now handle multi-step tasks on **Samsung's** Galaxy S26 and Pixel 10.
AI-Powered Features Expand - **Samsung's** Galaxy S26 series enhances user experience with new AI capabilities.
Preorders with Perks - **Samsung** offers up to $200 in gift cards for preorders of the Galaxy S26 series.
AI in Wearables - **CUDIS** launches health rings with an AI coach to incentivize healthy behaviors.
AI Infrastructure Opposition - Public discontent grows over AI data centers, prompting legislative action in several states.
